_comment: Enforced by .cursor/hooks/lane-guard.sh. docs/process/LANES.md is the human-readable companion; keep them in step. A lane may write only paths matching its own globs. Anything unclaimed is open. Editing the main checkout's source is denied outright - the owner plays there.
_contested: Owned by no single lane and shared by several. Denied to everyone BY DEFAULT: a silent parallel edit here is how work gets clobbered. A file that must change now has a legal path: the orchestrator adds a `grants` entry giving it to ONE lane, temporarily and with a reason. Contested is the resting state; a grant is the exception, not a re-owning.
_grants: A temporary, exclusive, auditable claim on a contested or otherwise-owned path, so a file that must change has a legal path to changing without being permanently re-owned. While a grant stands, the named lane may write the listed paths (this overrides contested AND another lane's ownership); every OTHER lane is denied them, exactly as if that lane owned them. Honoured by lane-guard.sh and reported by scripts/check-lane-integrity.mjs. Each entry states the lane, the exact paths, a reason, and the date granted, so the grant is visible and can be retired when the work lands. Keep the list short: a grant that outlives its work should be deleted, and if a lane keeps needing a path, give it the path outright instead.

grants.reason: The owner-approved atomic migration of M1's content set to the 1774 Coercive Acts slate. The module deck is on the critical path: verify:content couples its cue/check/concept ids to concepts.json, duel-items.json, codex-cards.json and the capstone, and apps/api's module-deck parity gate compares the server's transcription against it, so the deck cannot be migrated anywhere else and no partial pass is green-able. Replaces the module-lesson grant, whose stated retirement condition ('Retire when the lesson rework merges') was met when workflow/m1-lesson merged at 73a4b58 — that lane's Archive rework and the m1-sources manifest are both contained in main. Granted by the orchestrator on 2026-07-30 after the m1-1774 worker correctly REFUSED to grant itself the file and reported instead. This migration is cross-cutting by nature (~50 files across curriculum, content, apps/api, apps/web and packages/{duel,pvp,grading,mission-m1}); check-lane-integrity will report those as cross-lane edits, which are expected and authorised here rather than accidental. EXTENDED 2026-07-30 with the capstone-enable paths: the capstone can only be wired where the server serves it (api-hunt's apps/api/src/progression/content.ts plus its capstone/e2e/parity tests and the package.json test script), the subtitle comma bug can only be fixed where it lives (module-lesson's moduleShots.ts), and assessments.ts carries a now-false 'capstone is unwired' comment (boss-fight's) that is actively misleading once the capstone is enabled. KNOWN RECONCILIATION, not a conflict today: workflow/api-hunt adds test/pvp-shipping-card-gate.test.ts to the same apps/api/package.json test-script line, but that branch is PvP work deliberately paused under the M1-only freeze and is not on main — whoever resumes api-hunt must reconcile that one line to list both test files. Retire when the migration merges, and re-point lane-guard.sh's two grant-mechanism selftest cases at whatever grant is live then.

The holographic Archive room replaces the lesson index's flat DOM card list with a real 3D room (procedural shaders and postprocessing, which the asset rule explicitly permits for UI/Archive highlights). Deliberately the FIVE exact files it touches, not the apps/web/src/module/** glob: granting the glob is exclusive and therefore denies it to module-lesson and m1-lesson, which broke lane-guard's own ownership selftest case on ModulePlayer.tsx — the 'a grant overrides ownership in both directions' trap the map documents. A narrow grant records the writer without evicting the co-owners. apps/web/package.json and the CONTESTED pnpm-lock.yaml are included because the room needs @react-three/postprocessing, added via pnpm add in a worktree (the sanctioned path); the lockfile is contested precisely because a silent parallel edit there is unrecoverable, so this makes the change attributable. Granted by the orchestrator on 2026-07-30. Retire when the room merges — and note pnpm-lock.yaml returns to contested, denied to every lane, the moment it does.

The duel-HUD presentation rework retires the mid-fight interstitial card, moves hits-to-win onto the persistent HUD, deletes the raw damage numerals, and shows the unfired-balls rule once ever. The interstitial IS DuelOverlay.tsx and its styling IS duel.css, so the work cannot be done anywhere else. Both files are contested because boss-fight also had to touch the verdict label; that sequencing is now settled — boss-fight landed FIRST (540c0e3) specifically to protect the 'Not graded' verdict label, verified present on main afterwards — leaving duel-hud the single lane on these two files. Granted by the owner's explicit instruction on 2026-07-29 and recorded here the same day; the work is already committed on workflow/duel-hud at dab549b. A prior agent correctly REFUSED to grant this itself: a self-issued grant is the unrecorded authorisation the map exists to prevent. duel-hud MUST keep rendering verdictBeatTone(verdict).label in VerdictBeat — see the invariant row in docs/process/M1-STATUS.md. Retire when the HUD rework merges.

_retiredGrants: Retired 2026-07-29, both because their work merged: `mission-flow`'s four elm-beat UI files (MissionHud/MissionBeatPanel/missionInput/mission.css, merged 2c27d6a — those files are contested again, denied to every lane) and `camera-occluder`'s engine-world/MissionStage carve-out (merged d457081; the lane has no branch or worktree left and its entry is gone from `lanes`). Retired 2026-07-30, all three because their work is contained in main: `module-lesson`'s deck+schema grant (its own condition was 'retire when the lesson rework merges'; that rework merged at 73a4b58 and the deck grant is now re-pointed to `m1-1774` for the 1774 migration), `m1-sources`'s historical-sources.json (merged f6e5caf), and `m1-lesson`'s schema mirror (merged 73a4b58). Kept as prose rather than as dead grant objects: a grant that outlives its work silently re-owns a file. NOTE: `duel-hud`'s grant also describes merged work (dd0c07c/d798a61) and is a retirement candidate, but it is the live case lane-guard.sh's contested-override selftest stands on, so retiring it means re-pointing those cases too — deliberately left for a pass that owns the guard.
